summary: Aurelion Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing a press release announcing its second fiscal quarter 2026 financial results for the period ended March 31, 2026. The filing reports net asset value of $116.4 million ($3.16 NAV per share), participation in the XAUE protocol with a $48 million commitment, and operating income of $8.9 million driven by gold appreciation. There are no terms of a special situation transaction. This is a routine earnings release by a foreign private issuer under Rule 13a-16, with no acquisition, divestiture, or other special event. The filing includes an explanatory note incorporating the press release into an existing F-3 shelf registration.
